name: Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    name: Code style and tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: 🧪 Run all tests
        run: npm run test

      - name: 💄 Code style
        run: npm run check-style
